title: Like many, I have been having these dreams for the past 3 years and I didn't know it was a thing til recently...
content: So I figured I was just having these dreams because of nostalgia. I was a mall rat kid in the 90's. I have adhd and did have special experiences in which I was pulled out of class but I thought it was for reading and focus. I don't think just gifted and talented, tag or gate program kids have access to this dream world, like others have said there's many of us that are neurodivergent. One thing that frequently pops up is the freeways that aren't functioning. My freeways tend to have many scattered and jammed cars and people just get out of their cars and walk all in the same direction to the nearest tunnels or toll booths. Once you get to the entry point through the tolls everyone is sent in different directions. Sometimes I have access to the mall, sometimes I have gone to this weird under highway world with people camped out, gambling, fighting, some just picnicking. Sometimes there's a dmv like thing that's not actually a dmv but it's a testing facility and has this clinic like vibe with a lot of waiting around. I have so many parking garage dreams it's insane! Also some of my absolute favorite are a run down strip mall that has a secret entrance into and underground hazy mall where everyone is stuck in time in the early to mid 90's. The merchandise is all new but 90's nostalgic. It's truly crowded and full of life but some people seem real some seem like npcs. I could go in to more detail but I'm curious, so many of you are saying the dreams are abandoned and or scary/creepy. I have looked at some of your maps and see similarities to my dream mall worlds. I have one mall that's in an industrial town that's by a bay similar to havre de grace (where I live In Maryland) if I make it to the mall there's aquariums inside that are incredible! Once one broke sending dolphins and other life to the bay and left behind flooded stores. Anyway, I do believe in spirit guides and guardians. I have asked my spirit guides awhile back if they have any influence on my dreams and if they are used to transmit messages or information, scary dreams are not affective for me. It took some serious focus but, honestly, it worked. I mean, there are some surreal and bizarre and kinda creepy dreams, some more desolate, but none are like super scary they are more magical and uncanny. Also, there's always life. I think maybe when I experience more of the npc characters that I can't really interact with the areas feel more abandoned, and I wonder if they are just placed there for the illusion of life. Anyway, variations, but, a lot of similarities and I really look forward to hearing more about your dreams!
